entries.title: I Corinthians 13:1
segments: ¶If I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:2
segments: And if I have prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:3
segments: And if I shall dole out all my goods in food, and if I deliver up my body that I may be burned, but have not love, I profit nothing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:4
segments: ¶Love has long patience, is kind; love is not emulous [of others]; love is not insolent and rash, is not puffed up,

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:5
segments: does not behave in an unseemly manner, does not seek what is its own, is not quickly provoked, does not impute evil,

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:6
segments: does not rejoice at iniquity but rejoices with the truth,

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:7
segments: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:8
segments: ¶Love never fails; but whether prophecies, they shall be done away; or tongues, they shall cease; or knowledge, it shall be done away.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:9
segments: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part:

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:10
segments: but when that which is perfect has come, that which is in part shall be done away.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:11
segments: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I reasoned as a child; when I became a man, I had done with what belonged to the child.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:12
segments: For we see now through a dim window obscurely, but then face to face; now I know partially, but then I shall know according as I also have been known.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:13
segments: And now abide faith, hope, love; these three things; and the greater of these [is] love.
